title: Carrum Downs
content:
Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Carrum Downs

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Carrum Downs. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Carrum Downs has a mix of homes, sheds and commercial buildings, and we handle roofs of every size, from a verandah to a warehouse. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Carrum Downs: What We Commonly See

A few kilometres back from the bay, Carrum Downs is a real mix of established homes, newer estate housing and a sizeable industrial and commercial estate. The older homes have roofs that are now faded and weathered after years of sun, while the newer estates are largely COLORBOND®.

Sitting inland, the wear here comes more from heat, harsh UV and the south-east's hailstorms than from salt. The jobs we are called out for most in Carrum Downs are refixing cracked ridge capping, storm and hail damage, and replacing tired guttering, plus re-sheeting and fixing larger commercial and shed roofs.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Carrum Downs

From a family home to a warehouse, replacing a worn-out roof properly is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof and re-sheet Carrum Downs homes, sheds and commercial buildings in COLORBOND® steel, and we can also build and install flat metal roofing for low-pitch roofs and extensions.

Many older homes were built with roofs that contain asbestos cement sheeting. If that is your roof, we handle safe asbestos roof removal and replacement and finish the job in new COLORBOND® steel. We also convert older roofs to metal with our tile to tin service, and we will tell you honestly which option suits your home.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Carrum Downs

Our registered roof plumbers handle flashings, valleys, box gutters, downpipes and ridge capping on homes, sheds and commercial buildings. On larger roofs a failed box gutter or worn flashing can mean serious water damage, so we trace leaks back to the real source and fix them properly.

We replace guttering, downpipes and fascia capping in COLORBOND® steel, from a single damaged section through to a complete gutter replacement, and we carry out gutter repairs where a repair is all that is needed. We remove the old guttering cleanly and leave the site tidy.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Carrum Downs

Your quote depends on what your roof actually needs. Roof size, pitch and access, the type of steel and colour you choose, and how much plumbing work is involved are the main factors. We give you a clear written quote after an on-site inspection, so you know what you are paying for before any work starts.

Our Carrum Downs Roofing Process

We start with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. For a re-roof we strip the old roof, prepare the framing, fit insulation and sarking where needed, then re-sheet in new COLORBOND® steel with fresh flashings, ridge capping, gutters and downpipes. We leave the site clean and tidy when we are done.

Why Carrum Downs Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, so your job is done to standard and you are covered. As a local, family run business we treat your home the way we would treat our own, turn up when we say we will, and give honest advice rather than a hard sell. Carrum Downs Roofing FAQs

Do you do commercial and industrial roofs?

Yes. We re-sheet and re-roof sheds, warehouses and commercial buildings, and replace box gutters and flashings on larger roofs.

Can you fix hail and storm damage?

Yes. We fix dented sheeting, damaged flashings and storm-related leaks, and can advise whether a re-roof is the better option after major damage.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
